body:
**First live instance of this ruling — measured, same day it was made (2026-08-13 ~13:4xZ).**

Both in-flight `claude-fable-5` dev agents (#8428, #8433) were terminated mid-task by the account-level Fable 5 limit. Harness error text, verbatim:

> Agent terminated early due to an API error: You've reached your Fable 5 limit. Run /usage-credits to continue or switch models with /model.

Observed shape, worth landing in the platform facts table alongside the exemption text:

- **The wall is per-model-tier, not per-account-total** — the same session continues normally on `opus` after fable is exhausted. So the fallback this card writes down is not merely permitted, it is *available*: no waiting is required.
- **The failure is a mid-task kill, not a refusal to start.** #8428's agent died after opening its draft PR but before applying `skip-changeset` and returning its report; #8433's died while still reading, having written nothing. Both left their worktrees intact — nothing was lost, but neither returned a report, so **the dispatching PM must reconstruct completion state from GitHub** (PR existence, labels, branch) rather than from the agent's word. That is the existing "GitHub is the only authority" rule doing its job.
- **Consequence for the exemption's wording**: a downgrade decision may have to be made *mid-card*, on a re-dispatch, not only at first dispatch. The text should not read as if the tier is chosen once at claim time.

Seat action taken under the ruling: #8433 re-dispatched on `opus` with the downgrade and its reason recorded in the claim comment; #8428's remaining work (label + report) completed PM-side rather than by re-dispatching a dev.

Unchanged from the card: the exemption is conditional (fable measurably unavailable), floor is `opus` ⛔ never lower, and every downgrade records tier + reason in the claim comment's Container & model line; a downgrade decision may also happen mid-card at re-dispatch time.

Ruling-recording checks: outcome state is already `pm:queue` (no swap needed); no `Blocked-by:` lines to re-verify; serial position unchanged — dispatches once the dispatch-strategy card's PR frees the SKILL.md Model tiering section; no comment newer than the body amends the recommendation. The implementing dev proceeds on this ruling — the "maintainer may narrow at PR review" hedge in the body is discharged.
